Hi there,

Thanks for reaching out! Here's how to add a coworker to your workspace as an Editor:

1. Log in to Loopwise and open your workspace.
2. Click your workspace name in the top-left corner, then select "Members" (or "Workspace Settings" > "Members," depending on your plan).
3. Click "Invite Member."
4. Enter your coworker's email address.
5. In the role dropdown, select "Editor."
6. Click "Send Invite."

Your coworker will receive an email invitation. Once they accept and create or log into their account, they'll have Editor access to your workspace.

Note: only workspace Owners and Admins can invite new members, so if you don't see the "Invite Member" option, you may need to ask your workspace admin to add them or grant you the necessary permissions.

Let me know if you run into any issues or have other questions!

Best,
Loopwise Support
